claim_boundary: Single-crystal, literature-constrained CP-Ti baseline. The reported n* and k* are discrete-scan candidates, not batch-specific experimental predictions.

scan_contract.antipodal_domain: one hemisphere; real-coefficient Fourier conjugacy identifies n and -n
scan_contract.critical_time_definition: first log-linear crossing of max_(k,n) sigma_max(Phi) >= threshold
scan_contract.gain_observable: thermal plus 62 constitutive coordinates; displacement and velocity are propagated internally but excluded from input/output norms
